name: vgs-bc-mcp
description: Connect Claude Desktop to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central through Microsoft's official Business Central MCP server.
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to your Business Central environment (version 26 and later) through Microsoft's official MCP server. Every call runs under your own Business Central user, so your permission sets, security filters and licence apply unchanged.

**What the proxy adds**

- Browser sign-in with automatic device-code fallback, and silent token refresh afterwards.
- Instant tool list on start-up, with reconnect and retry on transient errors and rate limits.
- Read-only and destructive hints on every tool, so Claude asks before it writes.
- A clear note when Business Central refuses a call for lack of permission, and an optional setting to hide tools you may not use.
- Pass-through of resources and prompts for Business Central 28 and 29.

**Before you install**

You need an Azure app registration with the Business Central delegated permissions and 'http://localhost' as a mobile and desktop redirect URI. The settings below ask for its tenant ID and client ID, plus your environment and company name.

Maintained by Vangelder Solutions, an independent Microsoft partner; not affiliated with Microsoft or Anthropic. Privacy policy: https://vangeldersolutions.github.io/bc-mcp-proxy/privacy/

tenant_id.title: Azure Tenant ID
tenant_id.description: Directory (tenant) ID from the Entra admin center, Overview page.

client_id.title: Azure Client ID
client_id.description: Application (client) ID of your app registration. It needs the Business Central delegated permissions and public client flows enabled.

environment.title: Business Central Environment
environment.description: Environment name exactly as shown in the Business Central admin center, for example Production or Sandbox.

company.title: Business Central Company
company.description: Company name exactly as shown in Business Central (case-sensitive), for example CRONUS USA.

configuration_name.title: BC MCP Configuration Name
configuration_name.description: Name of the MCP Server Configuration to use. Leave empty to use the default configuration.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: INFO is recommended. Use DEBUG only when troubleshooting.

base_url.title: Business Central MCP endpoint
base_url.description: Leave the default for Business Central 28 and later. For version 27 and earlier use https://api.businesscentral.dynamics.com; the proxy adjusts scope and headers.

auth_mode.title: Authentication mode
auth_mode.description: auto (recommended): browser sign-in with device-code fallback. interactive: browser only. device_code: no browser, for headless hosts.

hide_unauthorized_tools.title: Hide tools the user may not use
hide_unauthorized_tools.description: Static tool mode only: hide the tools for pages you may not read (one extra read per page after connecting). Business Central still enforces every call.

allow_company_switch.title: Allow switching company
allow_company_switch.description: Let Claude run a call in another company of the same environment through a 'company' argument, and list the environment's companies with bc_list_companies. Business Central still enforces your permissions per company.

tools.name: bc_actions_search
tools.description: Search the Business Central actions (API pages and operations) available to the signed-in user. Read-only.

tools.name: bc_actions_describe
tools.description: Describe one Business Central action: its parameters, filters and the operations it allows. Read-only.

tools.name: bc_actions_invoke
tools.description: Invoke a Business Central action: read records, or create / update / delete / post when the MCP configuration allows writes. Treated as destructive.

tools.name: bc_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies of the Business Central environment (only when switching company is allowed). Read-only.
